tabs.summary: One row per field visit. 'Disbursed' is the total of Amount disbursed; a visit's district is the district of the village visited (Villages tab), with the officer's district (Officers tab) as a second option. Cancelled visits are left out unless asked for: use the 'not_cancelled' preset by default. To break down by officer, use 'Officer' (officer_name): the officer's full name from the Officers tab, so a first-name-only or differently-capitalised entry is the same line as the full name. 'Field officer' is the name as typed.

presets.not_cancelled: Done and follow-up visits (leave out cancelled) - the usual rule
